verses.text: Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix yalankan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel: --Tik wal tzeyilkani to ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix he k'an t'ayin, yuj chi' ix wak'kanoch jun winh ko reyal tik.

Haton jun winh tik ko reyal, a winh ol ex kuchb'anok. Ileknab'i, icham winak inxo, sakxo xil in jolom, haxo heb' winh wuninal ayoch heb' winh heyet'ok. Ha in ix ex in kuchb'ej yiktax kelem in, masanto tikne'ik.

Ayinek' t'a eyichanh tikne'ik. Tato ay mach ix wik'ek' junok nok' swakax, ma junok nok' sb'uru, mato ay mach b'aj ix wak' chukal, mato ay junok tas ix in cha t'ayex in montub'alok t'a elk'altak, alek t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ko reyal ix sik'el tik. Tato icha chi', syal in tupan tikne'ik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Malaj junelok ix ak' chukal t'ayonh, malaj b'aj ix a cha junok tas a montub'alok, xchi heb'.
--Ha Jehová yet' winh ix sik'och ko reyalok tik, testigo tz'ajkan heb' to malaj in mul ix och t'ayex, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Ma'ay, malaj tasi, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal chi': --Ha Jehová sik'annakel winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik yik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', scham wal eyab'an tas ol wal tikne'ik t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj tas wach' sk'ulejnak ku'uj yet' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'.

Ayik sk'ochnak winhaj Jacob yet' masanil yal yuninal t'a Egipto, te ya utajnak heb' yuj heb' anima ay ta'. Yalannak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová yik skolji heb' yuj. Haxo Jehová chi' ak'anb'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik sb'at yik'anelta heb' ko mam kicham chi' heb' winh ta'. Ak'jinakkan kajan heb' t'a tik yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal yuj heb', yuj chi' kotak skal ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yuj. Ay jun pekti' ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sísara, yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yik chonhab' Hazor. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Moab. Junjun makan heb' chi', ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ko mam kicham.

Yuj chi', juntak el tz'ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi', syalanxi sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, syalan heb': Mamin, ix och wal ko mul t'ayach, yujto ix ach kaktejkani, haxo Baal yet' Astarot skak' serwil. Ha tikne'ik jun, kolonh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'o'ol, a achxonhej ol ach kak' serwil, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix ak'jikot winhaj Jerobaal, winhaj Barac, winhaj Jefté yet' in tik yuj Jehová, yik tzex kolji t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'o'ol, yuj chi' syal heyaj t'a junk'olal.
Ayik ix heyilani to skot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita yak' owal ket'ok, ix he k'anan junok he reyal t'ayin, yik tz'och yajalil t'a ko kal, wach'chom a Jehová ko Diosal ko reyal yaji.
Ha tikne'ik ina winh he reyal ix he k'an tik. Toxo ix ak'jioch winh rey t'a ko kal yuj Jehová.

Ha tikne'ik, tze na' sik'lab'il to tze k'anab'ajej Jehová tzeyak'an serwil, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej icha snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal, tato tze k'anab'ajej winh he reyal tik, wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati.
Tato pit ol eyutej he b'a t'a tas syal Jehová jun, tato max he k'anab'ajej, ol yak'och yahelal t'a eyib'anh icha ix utaj heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha tikne'ik, maklejek heyila', yujto ol sch'ox Jehová junok tas satub'tak yilji t'a eyichanh.

Ha tikne'ik stiempo'al sjochchaj ixim trigo, manh stiempo'alok yak'an nhab'. Palta ol in k'an t'a Jehová to ol mak'waj k'u, ol yak'ankot nhab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to chuk ix he k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ayik ix he k'anan jun winh rey tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Jehová to skot nhab'. Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix mak'waj k'u ix kot nhab' chi', yuj chi' masanil anima ix xiw t'a Jehová yet' t'a winhaj Samuel chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' ix halan t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal yik max onh chami, yujto ix te wach' och ko mul yuj b'aj ix ko k'an ko reyal tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Wach'chom chuk tas ix he k'ulej chi', palta manh ex xiwok. Ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tik, manhxo eyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, haxonhej tzeyak' serwil t'a smasanil he k'o'ol.
Manh eyaktejkan Jehová yik tzex och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok tas syak' t'ayonh, max yalpax onh skolani.
Ha Jehová manh ol ex yaktejkan he ch'okoj, yik manh ol alchaj chukal t'ay, yujto snib'ej tzex och schonhab'ok.
Kolwajnhejokab' Jehová wet'ok yik tzin lesalwinhej eyu'uj yik max och in mul t'ay. Palta to ol ex in k'ayb'ej t'a stojolal.
Anhej to tze k'anab'ajej, tzeyak'an serwil Jehová t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tze na'ankot jantak tas wach' ix sk'ulej ku'uj.
Palta tato ol he k'ulejnhej chukal, ol ex satjokel yet' he reyal tik yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'.
